answer_1.quote: We introduce SNAC, a framework for collecting fine-grained annotations to evaluate Summary Narrative Coherence... We evaluate the depth 1 book summaries generated by a GPT-3 based model ... We generate summaries for the movie scripts dataset using the BART-based SummˆN model.

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics like ROUGE and BERTScore that are primarily used for evaluating long document summarization fail to penalize coherence errors in summaries.

answer_4.quote: We ask 3 Mechanical Turk workers ... to rate the overall coherence of 100 generated summaries on a 5-point scale. We also collect annotations from experts and crowdworkers who identify error spans in the summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to rate overall coherence on a 5-point Likert scale and to annotate specific coherence error spans according to the SNAC error schema.
